name: imx219_outdoor
description: The SAME pipeline and the SAME sensor mode as imx219_indoor, tuned for daylight instead. Only the numbers differ. Exposure is capped hard against motion blur, the metering target sits at the grey-card value, and grey-world fallback is off: outdoor scenes are often genuinely dominated by one colour -- foliage, sky, sand -- and falling back to grey world on those is how a lawn turns grey.
